declarations.description: Generates an accessible, themeable SVG QR code without sending its value to a remote service.
declarations.name: QrCode

slots.description: Optional logo or mark centered over the code. Prefer `error-correction="H"` and keep the mark small so the code remains scannable.
slots.name: center

members.name: value
members.description: Text or URL encoded by the QR code.

members.name: size
members.description: Rendered width and height in CSS pixels. Set to `0` to use `--c2-qr-code--size`.

members.name: errorCorrection
members.description: Error correction level: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), or H (30%).

members.name: margin
members.description: Quiet-zone width measured in QR modules. Four is recommended for reliable scanning.

members.name: boostErrorCorrection
members.description: Raises error correction when the encoded version has spare capacity.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name announced for the generated image. Defaults to `QR code`.

members.name: toSVG
members.description: Returns a standalone SVG string using the component's current value and options.

members.name: toDataURL
members.description: Returns a data URL for the current code. PNG export requires a browser document.

members.name: download
members.description: Downloads the current QR code as SVG or PNG.

events.name: qr-code-error
events.description: Fired when the value cannot be encoded. `detail` contains the error and rejected value.
